about-me.title: About me
about-me.description:
Fullstack Engineer with 8+ years of experience leading the frontend of large-scale CMS platforms (80+ sites, 50+ international domains) at Selectra. Specialized in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, PHP, Drupal and Laravel, with a recent focus on integrating AI (Claude API, OpenAI API) into real products to automate workflows and generate personalized content.

Experienced in mentoring teams and collaborating across engineering, product, SEO, and business stakeholders.

Specialized in web performance (Core Web Vitals), scalable frontend architecture, scripting and automation, and technical mentoring. Full-stack capable: comfortable making decisions that cross the frontend boundary.

My background combines advertising with software development, giving me a strong eye for documentation and user-centered product thinking.

experience.achievement-title: Core Web Vitals Optimization — Selectra CMS · 2025–2026
experience.achievement-desc:
• Context: PageSpeed stuck at ~57/100 on key sites, dragged down by structural CLS from images without declared dimensions
  • Solution: Python script that walked the monorepo and batch-processed thousands of Blade templates, injecting width/height on every img tag; complemented with manual above-the-fold fixes
  • Prevention: Git pre-commit hook via prepare script to block regressions
  • Outcome: PageSpeed 57 → 100. Approach is replicable across the full monorepo
  • Scaled a Design System (Atomic Design + BEM) into the standard adopted by every product team, not just my own
  • Automated the update of thousands of templates with Python that were previously edited one by one, by hand
  • Built internal tooling to automate development tasks across our multi-site monorepo spanning 50+ international domains
  • Mentored 5 junior developers, several of whom now lead their own projects
  • Outside of work, I build my own AI-powered tools to keep learning (see Projects & Portfolio)
